description: PAID, $0.001-$0.025 USDC. Any web page as clean, LLM-ready Markdown (boilerplate stripped) for your agent's context, e.g. url=https://example.com. Fetches the URL live (typically 1-5 s; stealth tier longer) and returns clean Markdown, JSON-LD, HTML tables and links as JSON. Tiers: cached_intel $0.001 (recent cached copy), static_scrape $0.005 (live fetch, default for normal pages), stealth_browser $0.025 (headless browser for JavaScript or Cloudflare-protected pages). An unpaid call returns the exact x402 price.

api_key.description: Optional prepaid key (sk_scrapling_...). Otherwise pay per call with x402 via _meta['x402/payment'].

css_selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope extraction.

name: scrape_url
